checklist.detail: Usa camera.room para la sala del player.

description: Cada Room llama a `has_player()` en cada frame de física (get_first_node_in_group de la cámara, Players.all.any con lambda, contains que sube por DungeonFloor.of); las cerradas además `enemies_inside()` y `waves_running()` (barrido de grupo + filter). `Targeting._sync_posts` corre cada frame aunque no tengas el gancho: hook_reach, grupo de postes y `_room_of` que recorre todas las salas, dos veces por poste.
notes: Done (335c775d with 7dbbba82 from 16.38). Instead of events, a lighter version: has_player looks up the camera once per physics frame for every room and loops without a lambda; a locked room checks enemies/waves every 6 ticks (LOCK_CHECK_TICKS). Hooking up Enemy.defeated/WaveSpawner would also need falls, pits and despawns: not worth it for this cost. _sync_posts returns without reach and only looks up rooms when a post is in reach (it doesn't use camera.room: in co-op each player has their own room).
title: Salas y targeting: dejar de consultar todo cada frame
